name: John F. Farnsworth

birth.place: Eaton, Quebec (born in Canada per Hammond)

bioAdditions: Hammond (S1) gives each generation: William Hammond (I) -> Lt. John Hammond (II) -> Abigail (III, m. John Hastings) -> John Hastings (IV) -> Hannah Hastings (V, b. Watertown 1716/17, m. 15 Aug 1735 Lt. David Farnsworth, a settler of 'No. 4' Charlestown, N.H., captured by the French and Indians in April 1757, escaped after seventeen days) -> Samuel Farnsworth (VI, b. 1750, drummer at Bunker Hill, later in Canada) -> John (VII, b. Stoddard, N.H., 15 May 1783, surveyor, d. Michigan 1844) -> John Franklin (VIII, b. 27 Mar 1820). 6th cousin 6 times removed.

sources.citation: Frederick S. Hammond, History and Genealogies of the Hammond Families in America, vol. 1 (1902) (archive.org full text), pp. 90-96
